purpose: Define how proposals produced by cortex agents and persistent organic agents become operator-reviewable interface objects and public candidates without leaking private execution state.
invariants: Every agent proposal is JSON before it is UI copy.
A proposal is operator-visible by default and public only after an explicit review transition.
Inference may propose, but it must not publish or mutate public-facing claims directly.
Private execution details, secrets, raw prompts, private IPs, credentials and bearer tokens are never part of the public projection.
A public proposal must cite inspectable evidence or declare the claim as unverified.
Rejected or superseded proposals remain useful operator evidence but must not be promoted as public outcomes.
A review event records operator judgment without mutating the original proposal envelope.
public_eligible=true is valid only when state == approved.
Review events are private operator evidence until a separate public projection passes redaction.

publication_gate: proof.evidence_refs is not empty or status_label declares unverified

interface_slots.purpose: Review all agent proposals, approve/reject them, request evidence and decide whether a proposal may become public.
Expose approved decision-grade proposals as public questions or public proof cards.
Expose approved build proposals only after proof and redaction gates are satisfied.

agent_obligations: include targets and coord_targets for repo-affecting proposals
include rollback shape when mutation is proposed
set visibility to operator_private unless the operator has approved publication
set public_projection.redaction_status to needs_review until redaction is proven clean
